title: Prime Minister congratulates Harvinder Singh and Vijay Sundi on winning Gold at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Harvinder Singh and Vijay Sundi for winning Gold in Men’s Recurve Doubles at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that their excellent performance has brought great pride to the nation, extending his best wishes for their future endeavours. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "A great achievement for Harvinder Singh and Vijay Sundi! Congratulations to the duo on winning Gold in Men’s Recurve Doubles at the Asian Para Games. Their excellent performance has brought great pride to the nation. My best wishes for their future endeavours: PM @narendramodi" A great achievement for Harvinder Singh and Vijay Sundi! Congratulations to the duo on winning Gold in Men’s Recurve Doubles at the Asian Para Games. Their excellent performance has brought great pride to the nation.
